title: PKG Studio module manifest
description: What a building block tells PKG Studio about itself (pkgstudio.module.json in the module root). Paths are relative to that root. See doc/embedding.md.

theme.description: Theme the module starts in; with theme-switch it reports changes through onThemeChange.

projectScoped.description: true: mounted per project under /<id>/<project>. false: mounted once, the module keeps its own project context.

css.description: Stylesheet the host imports once (the module does not import it itself).

source.description: Optional TypeScript entry for development (host's bundler transforms it).

package.description: Package export of the same entry, when the module is installed as a dependency.

export.description: Named export: start(options) => handle with apiHandle, mcpHandler, mcpRegistrar, ready, health, close.

build.description: Command (run in the module root) that produces the built entries.

mcpPath.description: Module-root-relative MCP endpoint, served by the backend handle's mcpHandler.

capabilities.description: mount-handle: mount() returns {unmount, onShow, onHide, navigate, setTheme, getTheme}. api-base: every request goes through the apiBase option. theme-switch: onThemeChange option. shell-tokens: reads --sh-* tokens. backend-handle: start() returns working handlers at once (503 until ready). health: handle.health(). mcp-endpoint: own MCP endpoint at mcpPath. mcp-registrar: handle.mcpRegistrar for the host's MCP gateway. host-principal: the backend start takes a principal(req) => {email} | null callback, so the host owns sign-in (with the frontend's authGate option).

envFile.description: Env file with the module's settings, passed as `env` to the backend start.

project.description: Env variable the host sets to its configured project for this module.
